description: Rotation correctness (item 14): after 2D rotation hover hits correct row, lasso selects correct rows, fit preserves angle, and PNG export is non-blank.
setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
k = rng.integers(0, 3, 3000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 5, (3, 8))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (3000, 8)), columns=[f'f{i}' for i in range(8)])
df['cat'] = [f'g{v}' for v in k]

steps.name: color by cat
steps.report: { colorColumn: a.colorColumn, renderVisibleCount: a.renderVisibleCount, nAnchors: a.nAnchors, nKept: a.nKept }

steps.name: baseline: screen vector between two far-apart points at rotation 0
steps.eval: window.__v0 = (() => { const xy = a.anchorXY, n = a.prepared.nAnchors; let j = 1, best = 0; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) { const dd = (xy[2*i]-xy[0])**2 + (xy[2*i+1]-xy[1])**2; if (dd > best) { best = dd; j = i; } } const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[0], xy[1]), q = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[2*j], xy[2*j+1]); return [q[0]-p[0], q[1]-p[1]]; })()

steps.name: the drawn map turned by 90 degrees (screen vector rotated, same length)
steps.eval: window.__v90 = (() => { const xy = a.anchorXY, n = a.prepared.nAnchors; let j = 1, best = 0; for (let i = 1; i < n; i++) { const dd = (xy[2*i]-xy[0])**2 + (xy[2*i+1]-xy[1])**2; if (dd > best) { best = dd; j = i; } } const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[0], xy[1]), q = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[2*j], xy[2*j+1]); return [q[0]-p[0], q[1]-p[1]]; })()
assert: (() => { const [x0,y0] = window.__v0, [x1,y1] = window.__v90; const l0 = Math.hypot(x0,y0), l1 = Math.hypot(x1,y1); return Math.abs(l1 - l0) / l0 < 0.02 && Math.abs((x0*x1 + y0*y1) / (l0*l1)) < 0.02; })()

steps.name: hover by screen position finds the point drawn there
steps.eval: const wx = a.anchorXY[0], wy = a.anchorXY[1]; const sc = a.renderer.projectWorld(wx, wy); const w = a.renderer.unproject(sc[0], sc[1]); window.__unproj = w; if (w) a['onPointer']({ x: sc[0], y: sc[1], world: w });

steps.name: fit does not reset rotation
assert: (() => { const xy = a.anchorXY, n = a.prepared.nAnchors, c = a.renderer.container; let out = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i += 7) { const p = a.renderer.projectWorld(xy[2*i], xy[2*i+1]); if (!p || p[0] < 0 || p[1] < 0 || p[0] > c.clientWidth || p[1] > c.clientHeight) out++; } return out; })() === 0
